# SJO LABS — Technical SEO & AI Search Index

> SJO LABS is a digital service studio delivering high-velocity Web Architecture, Mobile Applications, WordPress Solutions, AI Automation Workflows, AI Chatbots, AI Phone Agents, AI Search Visibility (AEO/GEO), and Meta & Google Paid Acquisition.

## Organization Summary
- **Legal Entity**: SJO LABS®
- **Website**: https://sjolabs.com
- **Core Focus**: Custom Web Engineering, Cross-Platform Mobile Apps, AI Agent Workflows, Answer Engine Optimization, and High-ROAS Paid Acquisition.
- **Target Markets**: Global (USA, Canada, UK, Australia, Nigeria)

## Primary Services Catalog (All 8 Services)

1. **Web Design & Web Development**
   - URL: https://sjolabs.com/services/web-design-web-development
   - Price: Starting from $500 (Typical range: $500–$1,500+)
   - Capabilities: Decoupled Next.js edge web architecture, Figma UI/UX, sub-second TTFB, conversion-engineered frontends.

2. **Mobile App Development**
   - URL: https://sjolabs.com/services/mobile-app-development
   - Price: Request a Quote / Starting from $600
   - Capabilities: iOS & Android cross-platform mobile apps (React Native), offline caching, real-time push notifications, cloud API synchronization.

3. **WordPress Development & Redesign**
   - URL: https://sjolabs.com/services/wordpress
   - Price: Starting from $400 (Typical range: $400–$800+)
   - Capabilities: Custom Gutenberg block theme development, performance optimization, security hardening, client-managed CMS.

4. **AI Automation Pipelines**
   - URL: https://sjolabs.com/services/ai-automation
   - Price: Starting from $200 (Typical range: $200–$500+)
   - Capabilities: 45-second autonomous lead triage, LLM intent screening, CRM synchronization (HubSpot, Salesforce), n8n/Make webhooks.

5. **AI Chatbots & Conversational Lead Intake**
   - URL: https://sjolabs.com/services/ai-chatbots
   - Price: Starting from $150 (Typical range: $150–$300+)
   - Capabilities: 24/7 knowledge-base trained website chat assistants, FAQ automation, lead intake, human agent handoffs.

6. **AI Phone Agents & Voice Receptionists**
   - URL: https://sjolabs.com/services/ai-phone-agents
   - Price: Starting from $250 (Typical range: $250–$500+)
   - Capabilities: 24/7 Voice AI receptionists, sub-800ms speech latency, emergency triage dispatch, direct calendar appointment booking.

7. **AI Search Visibility & AEO / GEO**
   - URL: https://sjolabs.com/services/ai-search-visibility
   - Price: Starting from $200 (Setup/Audit; ongoing from ~$200/mo)
   - Capabilities: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), JSON-LD schema microdata, content structuring for ChatGPT Search, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.

8. **Meta & Google Ads Campaign Management**
   - URL: https://sjolabs.com/services/meta-google-ads
   - Price: Request a Quote / Starting from $300/month
   - Capabilities: Paid acquisition campaigns, Server-Side Meta Conversions API (CAPI) relays, landing page conversion engineering, attribution telemetry.
